faq.q: What is Feria San Bernabe in Marbella?
faq.a: Feria San Bernabe is the annual fair in Marbella, typically held in June. It celebrates the city's patron saint with parades, flamenco, fairground rides, food stalls, and concerts. The fairground is located near the city center, and many visitors combine it with a yacht charter from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How do I book a yacht for Feria San Bernabe 2033?
faq.a: You can book directly via WhatsApp for any of our fleet. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) pricing is fixed at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. For Tier B (Mangusta 80) minimum 4 hours at €4,719 includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request. Early booking is recommended.

faq.q: What is included in the yacht charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees. You just need to bring your group and a good mood.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The provided drinks are complimentary, but you can customize the menu. Some boats have a cooler or fridge. Just avoid glass bottles on smaller vessels for safety.

faq.q: What is the best time for a boat party during the fair?
faq.a: Afternoon charters from 16:00-20:00 are popular, allowing you to enjoy sunset views and then head to the fairground. Morning trips (10:00-14:00) offer calmer seas. Evening charters (20:00-00:00) let you see the fair lights from the water.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a party of 12 people?
faq.a: For 12 guests, consider the Mangusta 80 (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Ferretti 94 (29m), or Maiora 26m. All depart from Puerto Banús and have spacious decks and saloons. The Mangusta 80 also comes with a free jet ski.

faq.q: Can we anchor near the fairground?
faq.a: The fairground is inland, so you cannot anchor directly there. However, you can anchor at nearby beaches like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim, then return to Puerto Banús and walk or taxi to the fair (about 10 minutes by car).

faq.q: Is there a dress code for a yacht party?
faq.a: Smart casual is typical: summer dresses, linen shirts, espadrilles. Avoid high heels on deck. Bring a light jacket for the evening breeze. For the fair, comfortable shoes are recommended as you'll be walking on grass and pavement.

data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabe 2033 is the highlight of Marbella's summer calendar, and a marbella yacht charter feria san bernabe boat party offers a unique way to celebrate. Combine the fair's vibrant atmosphere with a luxury yacht experience from Puerto Banús. This guide covers everything from fleet options and pricing to tips for making the most of your day on the water.

Why Combine a Yacht Charter with Feria San Bernabe?

The fair runs from 14-19 June 2033, with daytime parades and evening festivities. A yacht charter gives you a private base to relax, swim, and enjoy sunset views before heading to the fairground. You avoid the crowds on land and create a memorable pre-party or post-fair chill-out. Many groups book a 4-hour charter in the afternoon, then taxi to the fair for the night shows.

Our Fleet for Boat Parties

We operate from Puerto Banús with a range of boats suitable for groups of 5 to 12 guests. All include a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Below are the best options for a party:

For smaller groups, the Mariah SX21 (5 pax) or Speedboat (6 pax) are budget-friendly options. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Pricing and Inclusions

Our pricing is transparent. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. Every charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper and fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden extras. You can bring your own food and drinks if you prefer.

Recommended Itinerary for Fair Day

Start your day with a 12:00-16:00 charter: cruise along the coast to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim stop. Return to Puerto Banús by 16:00, freshen up, and head to the fairground (10-minute taxi). For evening parties, book 18:00-22:00 to watch the sunset over La Concha mountain and see the fair lights from the water. Some groups book a full 8-hour charter and split time between sea and fair.

Tips for a Successful Boat Party

  • Book early: Feria week is peak season; WhatsApp us at least 2 weeks ahead.
  • Maximize space: For 12 guests, choose a flybridge or open-deck boat like the Mangusta 80.
  • Music: Bring a Bluetooth speaker; most boats have AUX input.
  • Food: Order a catering platter from a local deli; we can recommend options.
  • Transport: Taxis from Puerto Banús to the fairground cost about €10-15.
  • Weather: June averages 28°C; bring sunscreen and a light jacket for evening.

Other Events During Feria Week

Besides the fair itself, Marbella offers: the Romería pilgrimage on 15 June, flamenco shows at the caseta municipal, and a fireworks display on the final night. A yacht charter lets you view the fireworks from the water – a spectacular perspective. For more ideas, see our Marbella yacht charter guide.
